digest.component_or_area: reconciliation differ and production snapshot mutation planning
propositions: The raw compute_mutations API must emit field_drift when local_state differs from jira_state as a positive control for correctness verification.
The production snapshot caller passes both arguments as remote Jira state and must suppress field_drift and unbound_local emissions at the call site via A4-1's filter to honor the differ contract.
Genuine inbound-create and invariant-seed mutations must survive the call-site filter and not be suppressed.
A converged reconciliation pass must record mutation_count==0 when processing snapshot pairs with no real local state changes.
No source, test, or documentation changes are warranted; A4-1's load-bearing suppression filter and characterization tests must remain intact.
